sections.heading: What is Prathibimba?
sections.content: The B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 celebration is titled Prathibimba — Our Heritage. Our Story. It takes place on one day, Sunday 15 November 2026, at Brigade 7 Gardens. Everyone is welcome. The schedule is in the Programmes section of the website.

sections.heading: 15 November 2026 — morning session: Samvada with the Chief Guests and B7G Santhe inauguration
sections.content: The morning session of 15 November 2026 runs from 8:30 to 11:00 AM: arrival of guests (8:30), breakfast with the Chief Guests (8:45), invocation song by Poornima and lamp lighting (9:10), welcome address by the President (9:20), Samvada — interaction with the Chief Guests Shri Dharmendra Kumar Arenahalli and Shri Neernalli Ramakrishna (9:30 – 10:30), Chief Guests' interaction with the GSS team (10:30), and the inauguration of B7G Santhe (10:45 – 11:00). Santhe stays open until the evening.

sections.heading: 15 November 2026 — evening session: cultural programme, sand art and jamming
sections.content: The evening session (cultural programme) of 15 November 2026 starts at 4:40 PM, with Kannada actor Nagabhushana NS as the evening Chief Guest. Performances by B7G residents and groups run from 4:40 to 7:05 PM, followed by sand art by Mr. Raghavendra Hegde (7:05 – 8:00 PM) and jamming (8:45 – 10:30 PM).
